meta.name: image-to-video
meta.description: Still-to-video conversion guide: model selection, motion prompting, and camera movement. Covers Wan 2.5 i2v, Seedance, Fabric, Grok Video with when to use each. Use for: animating images, creating video from stills, adding motion, product animations. Triggers: image to video, i2v, animate image, still to video, add motion to image, image animation, photo to video, animate still, wan i2v, image2video, bring image to life, animate photo, motion from image

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将静态图片转为动态视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想把照片或图片变成有动态效果的视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn static images into dynamic videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to animate photos or images into videos

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你提供的图片和文字描述，调用多个 AI 模型生成动画视频，并指导你选择模型、编写运动提示词、控制镜头运动。
howto.when: 当你要求将静态图片转为视频，或提到“图片转视频”、“i2v”、“给图片加运动”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 把这张风景图变成一段有云朵飘动和水波荡漾的视频。
用 Fabric 1.0 让这张衣服图片的布料飘动起来。
say.note: Claude 会选用专门处理布料物理的模型。

say.text: 给这张产品图做一个缓慢环绕的动画，并添加音频。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate animated videos from still images using multiple AI models, guide model selection, motion prompting, and camera movement.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to convert a still image to video, or mention keywords like "image to video", "i2v", "animate image", etc.

say_en.text: Turn this landscape photo into a video with drifting clouds and rippling water.
say_en.note: Claude will use Wan 2.5 i2v for natural motion.

say_en.text: Use Fabric 1.0 to make the fabric in this clothing image flow.
say_en.note: Claude will select the specialized cloth physics model.

say_en.text: Create a slow orbiting animation of this product with audio.
say_en.note: Claude will use Seedance 2.0 with audio generation enabled.
